description: Creator 32K BF16 profile with TensorFold 757a851a, b12x b58f34ea, SAGE EXL3 cc64e77b and DFlash2 425aa615. TP4, BF16 latent KV, DCP1, 32,768-token context and seven-token DFlash at confidence 0.60. Original BF16 head bytes are extracted offline from the exact 5.36 GB source shard and verified before atomic cache publication; the corrected template and model index live in a separate cache view. Preserves creator tile pinning, RoCE equality checks, startup/per-request consensus, poisoned-rank exits and warm-up. Controller owns placement, exposure and lifecycle. The 114 GB per-node peak is an estimate derived from upstream capacity observations and the documented KV slope. The smaller creator-tested context preserves the platform memory floor; the upstream 160K profile reached only 4.86 GiB available. Physical four-Spark acceptance is unverified.
title: GLM-5.3 EXL3 3.38bpw TensorFold four Spark (vcruz305) (32K BF16)
